grammar.summary: 本课学习表应答的 it is / it does 强调结构。

points.title: 替代动词 do/does 表避免重复
points.explanation: 'Do you smoke?' 'No, I don't.' 助动词替代前文实义动词；'I stopped doing it.' 回应中 it 指代上文整体。

examples.en: After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health', I lit a cigarette.
examples.cn: 读完《吸烟与健康》一文后，我点了一支烟。

points.title: 表"戒除"的结构
points.explanation: gave up smoking = 戒烟，give up + 动名词；同 stop doing（停止）。

examples.en: I gave up smoking for a while.

exercises.q: I think he kept ___ the meeting on purpose.
He kept ___ making the same mistake.
Keep ___ the floor. I have just finished clean.
